step1.title: Describe your parcel
step1.subtitle: The more precise you are, the fewer surprises at handover.

goldenRules.title: Golden rules for a smooth shipment
goldenRules.pack: **Pack carefully.** Sturdy bag or box, bubble wrap if fragile, properly taped.
goldenRules.weigh: **Weigh precisely.** Declared weight must match actual weight at handover.
goldenRules.describe: **Describe accurately.** {carrierFirstName} will inspect the content before accepting.

basic.title: Basic protection
basic.description: Your money is held until delivery. If the parcel is not handed over, you are refunded.

extended.title: Yamba Guarantee {cap}
extended.description: Loss, theft or damage on the way: you are refunded up to {cap}.
extended.ipidText: Excluded: prohibited items, a parcel that does not match its description, customs seizure, and damage caused by insufficient packaging. The refund never exceeds the content value you declared. Photos of the parcel are required.

step2.title: Where, and to whom?
step2.subtitle: The meeting point first, then the person who collects the parcel. They do not need a Yamba account.

deliveryFlow.title: How the delivery will work
deliveryFlow.codeGiven: **A 6-digit code** will be given to you after payment.
deliveryFlow.shareIt: **You share it** with the recipient by SMS, WhatsApp or in person.
deliveryFlow.handToTraveler: **They give it to the Traveler** at delivery. Without this code, the parcel cannot be released.

form.phoneHint: The delivery code will be sent by SMS / WhatsApp — pick their country code.
form.emailHint: To notify the recipient when the parcel arrives

step3.title: Your commitment
step3.subtitle: You certify on your honor the content of the parcel

handoverFlow.title: What will happen when you hand over the parcel
handoverFlow.visualInspection: **Mandatory visual inspection.** The Traveler will examine your parcel before accepting — don''t be surprised.
handoverFlow.refusalPossible: **Refusal possible if non-compliant.** If the content differs from your declaration, the Traveler can refuse. You''ll be refunded but the trip is lost.
handoverFlow.crossPhotos: **Cross-referenced photos.** The Traveler will take their own photos as evidence in case of dispute.

charter.title: Shipper Charter
charter.subtitle: Legal commitment — read carefully
charter.intro: By confirming this deal, I declare and guarantee on my honor that my parcel:
charter.noIllicit: contains **no illicit**, dangerous or prohibited products
charter.matchDeclared: matches exactly the **declared category, weight and content**
charter.customsCompliant: complies with the **customs regulations** of the destination country
charter.disclaimer: Any false declaration engages my sole civil and criminal liability, to the exclusion of the Traveler and Yamba.
charter.fullLink: See the full charter and prohibited items

accept.title: I accept the Shipper Charter
accept.descPrefix: I have also read and accept the

afterPayment.title: After your payment
afterPayment.step1: The Traveler receives your request and has **24h to accept**. You''re only charged on acceptance.
afterPayment.step2: Meet the Traveler for the **handover**, where they''ll inspect and photograph the parcel.
afterPayment.step3: Once the parcel is handed over, you receive your **6-digit code**, to share with the recipient.
afterPayment.step4: The recipient gives the code to the Traveler at arrival, who enters it to confirm delivery.
afterPayment.step5: **3 days after** confirmed delivery, the Traveler receives their payment.

step4.trustStripe: Payment secured by Stripe. Yamba never stores your card details.
